text:
Marcus T: Hey folks — just finished HR onboarding. I don't see my HubSpot or Gong accounts yet. Also quick question about call recordings: what's our retention policy and can SDRs tag recordings for training?

Hannah (Sales Ops): Welcome @Marcus T! Send me your employee id and I'll queue the HubSpot seat. Gong invites come from enablement@redwood.ai.

Marcus T: emp id RWF-2399, email marcus.t@redwood.ai. Thanks!

privacy-bot: Welcome Marcus! Please note: any recordings used for model training require explicit consent and a privacy review. See https://redwood.docs/legal/recording-policy for details.

Hannah (Sales Ops): Got it — OPS ticket OPS-3045 created for HubSpot + Gong provisioning. Expect emails in ~10-15m. For SDRs the default recording retention is 90 days; CS folks have 365 days. If you need extended retention for a specific deal, tag it and ping legal.

Marcus T: Good to know. Who can add tags like #training or #sensitive to recordings?

Privacy Team: @Marcus T Only designated reps can mark recordings as #training. That group includes enablement and legal until we certify more folks. If you want recordings used for internal coaching, use the #coaching tag — enablement auto-archives those for 60 days.

Elaine: Marcus — welcome! :tada: Playbooks and call templates are here: https://redwood.docs/sales/onboarding/new-hire-playbook. Focus on the "Intro > Discovery > Close" script in week 1. For tagging, use these short tags on Gong: `#demo`, `#followup`, `#training`, `#no-demo`.

Ben H: I'll be your buddy. I'll put two shadow sessions on your calendar tomorrow 11am & 2pm PT. Marcus, share availability and preferred timezone.

Marcus T: Thanks Ben! I'm PT and both times work.

Marcus T: One more question about Dialpad caller ID/voicemail setup — do I pick a number or is that assigned?

Marta (IT): Dialpad numbers are assigned by Telecom. We normally put new SDRs on the shared pool. If you want a dedicated DID, file TELE-77 or ping me and I'll expedite. Voicemail greeting: brief intro + one-sentence CTA.

Hannah (Sales Ops): Quick checklist for @Marcus T: [x] HR done, [ ] HubSpot seat (OPS-3045), [ ] Gong invite, [ ] Dialpad number (TELE-77 if dedicated), [ ] Playbook access. Ping this thread if anything stalls.

Marcus T: All right, I'll wait for the invites and will not upload any recordings externally until I get clearance. Appreciate the help!

Elaine: Welcome again 389 389 See you in the shadow session.

(END OF THREAD)
